name: setup-zig
description: Install and cache a verified Zig toolchain in GitHub Actions

scripts.build: deno task --cwd modules/zon-ts pack && ncc build src/index.js -o dist --minify && ncc build src/post.js -o dist/post --minify
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js && deno task --cwd modules/zon-ts test
scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/post.js && deno check modules/zon-ts/src/mod.ts && deno lint modules/zon-ts

author: Jassiel Ovando
